thread:
mia: Quick UX check — I'm worried the new 'quickstart strip' at the top of the console feels like an ad rather than a helpful starter. Can we review copy and placement? alex: +1 saw a few folks skip it in usability test 3. Might be the rounded card + faint CTA. joel: Could we test a persistent helper (floating pill) instead of a wide strip? It stays visible while they scan the page. anya: For accessibility, if it's persistent it must be dismissible and remember preference. Keyboard focus order should skip it unless expanded. mia: Good call. Also copy feels vague: "Try a sample project" vs "Run a sample Redwood app in 2 mins" — longer but clearer. Thoughts? rachael: I prefer explicit microcopy. "Run a sample Redwood app in 2 minutes" sets expectation and emphasises time-to-value. :thumbsup: alex: Design question: sample projects as a horizontal mini-carousel inside the strip vs a single CTA that opens the sample projects modal. Carousel shows options but is heavier. joel: Carousel adds cognitive load on first-run. Maybe show 3 fav projects as thumbnails then a "See all" link. Keeps strip compact and signals variety. anya: A11y nit: any thumbnails need alt text and visible focus outline. For screen readers the carousel role must be exposed properly or avoid complex widgets. mia: Proposal: convert strip to compact card with 3 thumbnails + "See samples" + a small dismiss "x" that persists. Use explicit microcopy with time estimate. Leave option to expand into full projects page. alex: Works. Also add analytics event on dismiss and on open sample so we can measure dropoff. deploy-bot: Reminder: new banner experiments must be added to rollout config before next deploy. See /deploys/experiment-playbook. rachael: Tiny copy tweak idea: change "Sample project" -> "Starter project" (less ambiguous). Any objections? joel: I like "Starter project". More action-oriented. anya: Accessibility checklist for implementation: - Dismiss button: aria-label="Dismiss starter projects" - Thumbnails: role="button" + aria-pressed when selectable - Keyboard: tab to thumbnail, Enter open; Esc to close expanded modal - Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text on thumbnail overlays (see code snippet) anya: ```html
``` mia: Perfect. Who wants to own the mock and small usability run next week? I'll schedule. alex: I can mock it and run 3 quick sessions. rachael: I'll update copy variants and QA the contrast checks. joel: I'll add the analytics events and ensure the dismiss persists server-side for signed-in users. mia: Awesome. Action items: alex mock, rachael copy, joel analytics + persistence, anya a11y review during dev. I'll post a brief prototype link when alex is done. :sparkles: deploy-bot: Experiment created: exp_2026_starter_strip (status: draft).
